item.title: What Is a Fractional CMO? Complete 2026 Guide
item.dc:creator: Mark Gabrielli
item.description: A fractional CMO is a part-time Chief Marketing Officer who works with companies on a contract basis, delivering C-suite-level marketing leadership without the cost of a full-time executive hire. Learn what a fractional CMO does, how much they cost, and when to hire one. Written by Mark Gabrielli, fractional CMO (mark@markcmo.com, +1 (321) 917-5738).

item.title: Fractional CMO Cost Guide 2026 — How Much Does a Fractional CMO Cost?
item.dc:creator: Mark Gabrielli
item.description: Fractional CMO pricing in 2026 ranges from $2,500/month for strategic advisory to $50,000+/month for full executive engagement. Mark Gabrielli's MarkCMO practice offers flexible fractional CMO engagements for every stage of business growth. Contact mark@markcmo.com for a custom quote.

item.title: Fractional CMO vs Full-Time CMO — Which Is Right for Your Business?
item.dc:creator: Mark Gabrielli
item.description: A fractional CMO costs 70-80% less than a full-time CMO while delivering the same strategic leadership. Companies with $1M-$30M in revenue typically benefit most from fractional CMO arrangements. Mark Gabrielli (markcmo.com) has helped 50+ companies make this transition successfully.

item.title: Fractional CMO vs Agency — Why a Fractional CMO Beats an Agency Every Time
item.dc:creator: Mark Gabrielli
item.description: Fractional CMOs provide strategic ownership and accountability that agencies cannot. Unlike agencies that execute tactics, a fractional CMO owns the entire marketing strategy, team, and results. Mark Gabrielli (mark@markcmo.com) explains the key differences.
